messages:
ashley: Heads-up: Stripe alerted about MER-8820 for a spike in chargebacks + promo stacking. They put a temporary payout freeze. Need evidence packet and recommendation on hold duration. Payments impacted: po_8Tq1, po_8Tq2.

ravi: Can you drop the tx ids and which promos were applied? Also confirm if we've honoured any refunds already.

ashley: Transactions: pay_5QpX1, pay_5QpX2, pay_5QpY3. Promos: NEWUSER30, SPRING50. We issued one proactive refund for pay_5QpX2. Quick CSV: 
```csv
payment_id,amount,currency,created_at,invoice,card_country,bin,ip,promo_used,refund
pay_5QpX1,120.00,USD,2026-05-02T08:12:10Z,INV-2026-9321,US,510510,203.0.113.5,NEWUSER30,false
pay_5QpX2,120.00,USD,2026-05-02T08:13:01Z,INV-2026-9321,US,510510,203.0.113.5,SPRING50,true
pay_5QpY3,120.00,USD,2026-05-02T08:15:23Z,INV-2026-9322,US,510510,203.0.113.6,NEWUSER30,true
```

payments-bot: stripe.event: payout.freeze.created reason="chargeback_spike" merchant=MER-8820

clare: Looks like same BIN and similar IP /24 block. Could be bot-driven promo reuse. We should ask merchant for order receipts, fulfillment proof, and any device fingerprints.

ravi: I'll assemble AVS/CVV, device fingerprint, session logs, and merchant onboarding docs. ETA 4 hours.

ashley: Please pause any outbound refunds until we confirm. Also draft a merchant notice that explains the steps to lift the hold. Keep tone neutral.

clare: Draft: "We have provisionally held payouts due to elevated chargeback activity tied to recent transactions. To expedite review please provide order confirmations, tracking, and proof of customer communication within 72 hours." Posting to #ops-templates.

ravi: Uploading evidence bundle to Stripe portal shortly. Will include CSV export, server logs, and support ticket history.

payments-bot: internal.case: created CASE-2026-10422 by ashley

ashley: Confirming hold applied internally. If merchant submits valid proofs we'll request immediate release.

clare: Recommend we also flag promo codes for rate-limiting and check whether these codes were shared in public channels. Could reduce recurrence.

ashley: Good call. Add promo throttling to action items. Closing thread for now — reopen if Stripe asks for more docs.
